Title: Single-Neuron Network and Chain Rule
Summary: The lecture models a simple neural network with single neurons per layer, defining key components like activations (a^l), weighted sums (z^l), and the cost function C = (a^l - y)^2. It explains how the chain rule breaks down the derivative of cost with respect to weights into three parts: ∂C/∂a^l, ∂a^l/∂z^l, and ∂z^l/∂w^l, illustrating the flow of gradients.
